questions.question: Which of the following is a rabi crop?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Rapeseed) है।

questions.question: Which country banned the entry of the UN Secretary-General António Guterres in October 2024 for 'failing' to condemn Iran's attack?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Israel) है।

questions.question: According to Article 165, which of the following qualifications is required for a person to be appointed as the Advocate General of a State?
options: Qualified to be appointed a Magistrate
Qualified to be appointed a Judge of a High Court
Qualified to be appointed a Judge of a District Court
Qualified to be appointed a Judge of the Supreme Court
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Qualified to be appointed a Judge of a High Court) है।

questions.question: Which animal is renowned for its ability to regenerate lost body parts?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Zebrafish) है।

questions.question: Which of the following stages are involved in beer-production?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Malting, brewing and fermentation) है।

questions.question: As per the Provision of _______ of the Indian Constitution, the Lok Sabha is the lower house of the Parliament.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Article 79) है।

questions.question: During which of the following years was gender budgeting introduced in India?
Which of the following books was NOT written by Jhumpa Lahiri?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The Ministry of Utmost Happiness) है।

questions.question: In which type of forests are Sal, Shisham and Hurra trees found in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Tropical deciduous forests) है।

questions.question: Who designed the impressive Albert Hall building in Jaipur, India, in the Indo-Saracenic style?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Samuel Swinton Jacob) है।

questions.question: Who among the following was one of the founders of the ‘Hindustan Republican Association’ in 1924?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Ram Prasad Bismil) है।

questions.question: The unit of force is different from the unit of _______.
options: rate of change of angular momentum
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (rate of change of angular momentum) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Fundamental Duties of the Indian Constitution was inserted through the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2002?
options: To develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform
To provide opportunities for education to his child or as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years
To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To provide opportunities for education to his child or as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years) है।

questions.question: In February 2025, Rekha Gupta took oath as the Chief Minister of ________________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Delhi) है।

questions.question: In which year did Babasaheb Ambedkar organise a non-violent struggle for entry into the Kala Ram Temple in Nasik?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (1930) है।

questions.question: Which of the following equations correctly represents the calculation of speed?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Speed = Distance / Time) है।

questions.question: Kabini and Bhavani are tributaries of the _____________ river.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Kaveri) है।

questions.question: Narasimham Committee-1998 is related to _______.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (banking sector reform) है।

questions.question: India holds the ________ position in worldwide production of jaggery as per the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (first) है।

questions.question: Which company/organisation launched the AI-based Agromet Advisory Service (Agromet) in 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (ICRISAT and ICAR) है।
